title: Patterns in art
examples: Teacher, how do I find the next shape?
Can we make a pattern with colours?
What is a pattern in art?

explain.say: Look at these shapes: circle, square, circle, square. This is a pattern.
Now look at colours: blue, red, blue, red. The colours repeat in the same order.
A pattern can mix shapes and colours. Blue triangle, red circle, blue triangle, red circle.
Patterns are all around you. The stripes on a zebra repeat.
To continue a pattern, repeat the whole group again.
Look at the whole pattern, from the start. Find the group that repeats.

faq.q: What is a pattern in art?
faq.a: A pattern is when things repeat in a piece of art. It makes the art look neat and organised.
asks: How do I spot a pattern?
What does repeating mean in art?

faq.q: Do I have to use the same shapes every time?
faq.a: No, you can use different shapes as long as they follow the same repeating rule. For example, big then small.
asks: Does the shape have to be the same?

faq.a: No, patterns can be shapes, colours, or both shapes and colours together. They can be anything that repeats.
asks: What if it is shapes and colours?

faq.q: How do I know where the pattern starts?
faq.a: Look at the start of the art. Find the first group that repeats.
Some patterns are harder. Look closely at the first few items to find the rule.

facts: Patterns help make art look balanced and neat.
You can find patterns in nature, like in leaves.
A pattern can repeat shapes, colours, or both.
The rule for the pattern is the group that repeats.

quiz.say: Look at the pattern. What comes next?
quiz.why: The pattern repeats star, moon. After moon comes star.

wrong.1: Moon came last, so the pattern goes back to star.
wrong.2: The sun is a new picture, and this pattern uses stars and moons.

quiz.say: Look at the pattern. What colour comes next?
quiz.why: The group is red, blue, blue. After two blues comes red.

wrong.0: There are already two blues, so the group starts again with red.
wrong.2: Green is a new colour, and this pattern uses red and blue.

quiz.say: Look at the pattern. Which group repeats?
quiz.why: Yellow, green is the group. It repeats again and again.

wrong.0: In this pattern, each yellow sits next to a green.
wrong.1: In this pattern, each green sits next to a yellow.
